title: Calibrating a held-out-trial falsification rule
question: When one trial is withheld and its contrast predicted from the rest, which pass or fail rule holds its type I error, how much power does it have, and what does omitting a variance component or mis-targeting the prediction do?
design: One individual-data trial and five aggregate trials with a continuous outcome and linear effect modification; 24 cells crossing violation size, heterogeneity, covariate spread and withheld-trial position; full, naive, mis-targeted and decision-flip rules. 2000 replicates per cell.
